description: The ready WakeHuBERT 'hey mycroft' model that ovos-ww-plugin-wakeforge ships as its default wake-word engine, at the model's own calibrated default threshold (0.18).
notes: Plugin default config: the ready model named in 'model', fetched from OpenVoiceOS/wakehubert-wakewords at the revision the plugin pins; threshold, smoothing and debounce come from the model's own metadata. Training data per the model card: synthetic speech only: text-to-speech clips from TigreGotico/synthetic-wakeword-hey_mycroft (edge-tts, Piper with LibriTTS-R speakers, Amazon Polly, OVOS TTS plugins, OmniVoice, and Chatterbox and OpenVoice conversions onto Common Voice speakers, CC BY 4.0) and further edge-tts and Google Translate TTS clips, with eight held-out edge-tts test voices excluded.
